y_true.description: Ground truth values with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN]`.
constraints: y_true shape is broadcast-compatible with y_pred shape

y_pred.description: The predicted values with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN]`.
constraints: y_true shape is broadcast-compatible with y_pred shape

output.description: Logcosh error values with shape = `[batch_size, d0, .. dN-1]`.

constraints: y_true shape is broadcast-compatible with y_pred shape
